name: Project Evaluation Workflow
description: Workflow used to evaluate a retrieval experiment from implementation through final evaluation.

states.name: Project Started
states.description: The experiment has been selected and work can begin.

states.name: Implementation
states.description: Implement the experiment or retrieval system.

states.name: Tests Written
states.description: Unit tests have been created for the experiment.

states.name: Experiment Tests Passed
states.description: The experiment-specific test suite has passed.

states.name: Full Test Suite Passed
states.description: The complete project test suite has passed.

states.name: Evaluation Complete
states.description: Retrieval metrics have been calculated and inspected.

transitions.condition: All required tests have been written.

transitions.action: Run the evaluation and inspect retrieval metrics.

name: Adaptive Memory Retrieval Workflow
description: Workflow representing the adaptive retrieval process from query routing to final memory selection.

states.name: Query Received
states.description: A user query has entered the memory system.

states.name: Query Routed
states.description: The memory router has selected relevant memory sources.

states.name: Memory Retrieved
states.description: Relevant memories have been retrieved from the selected sources.

states.name: Memories Fused
states.description: Results from multiple retrieval sources have been combined.

states.name: Conflicts Resolved
states.description: Conflicting memories have been detected and resolved.

states.name: Context Ready
states.description: The final memory set is ready to be converted into conversational context.

transitions.action: Retrieve memories from the selected sources.
transitions.condition: At least one retrieval route is selected.
Multiple memories may contain contradictory information.
The final retrieval set has been resolved.
